title: SORTENTSTABLE target-key scratch compaction
scope: Reduce duplicate scratch ownership in typed SORTENTSTABLE projection validation.
Preserve target/key conflict rejection, repeated identical pairs, and ASCII/binary output behavior.

sourceChange.before: Maintain targetKeys for conflict detection and sourceKeys as a second hash map of per-target vectors containing each repeated key.
sourceChange.after: Maintain one sourceKeys map from target handle to its common key and duplicate count; reject a conflicting key and emit the same key count times.
sourceChange.effect: Removes one full target-key hash index and per-target vector allocations/key elements while preserving accepted repeated-pair count and order.

focusedTests.coverageNote: Existing test rejects conflicting duplicate keys and accepts/reimports repeated identical pairs in ASCII and binary DXF.

validation.diffCheck: passed for dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Closes one duplicated scratch index in the 7S.2c projection audit without changing semantics, public API, test cadence, support claims, or external qualification gates. The broader route-by-route audit remains open.

testsRun: Focused existing SORTENTSTABLE adapter round-trip CTest
method.limitations: The change reduces object count and retained duplicate key storage but does not measure allocator overhead, peak RSS, or every writer-side scratch structure. It is not a whole-process memory-bound claim.
